concept: Lambda: serverless for short, spiky workloads
tests: Choosing compute with no server management and pay-per-request billing for unpredictable traffic and short executions.
expected: AWS Lambda — scales automatically with request count, billed per invocation and execution time. Triggers: "unpredictable, spiky", "avoid managing servers", "pay per request", "few seconds".
why_not: EC2 with Auto Scaling and ECS on EC2 require managing and paying for instances; EMR — for big data clusters.
